newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end up as synthetics rise.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end up as synthetics rise.

text.p: Pakistani stocks finished higher on Thursday amid talk of higher duties on import of synthetic fibres likely to help local manufacturers to beat competition from imports.
"The index moved up with the rise in ICI and Dewan Salman, having a spillover effect on the market," dealer Ali Raza of KAB Securities said.
The Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) 100-share index rose 5.38 points, or 0.35 percent, to end at 1,547.27. Losers led gainers 193 to 86. Turnover fell to 57 million shares from 72 million on Wednesday.
PTCL rose 0.45 to 25.20 rupees, ICI Pakistan 0.75 to 24.85, Hub Power 0.45 to 37.90 and Dewan Salman Fibre 0.80 to 36.45.
FFC Jordan fell fell 0.05 to 16.85 and Fauji Fertilizer 1.0 to 82. Muslim Commercial Bank rose 0.05 to 35.05
